thread:
incident-bot: INCIDENT ALERT: region eu-west-1 - partial networking/connectivity degradation detected. Auto-page to #incidents and @sre-oncall. Metrics: ELB target failures and Route53 response latency spike.

maria: ACK. I'm on it, pulling dashboards.

dan: seeing ~30-45% unhealthy targets on app-elb-prod in eu-west-1b, healthchecks 5xx and timeouts. ELB LCW shows connection resets. EBS io4 volumes in the same AZ also show increased i/o wait (p95 > 2500ms).

sre-oncall: @maria @dan assigning severity: SEV-2 for now (partial region impact). Which services failing? any customer-facing 5xx spikes?

maria: request rates steady, but error rate to customers in EU region up ~12% p90. Support queue has 5 active tickets referencing timeouts. No global failures yet.

neteng: we see abnormal control-plane errors from EC2 in eu-west-1b - instance status checks flapping, ENI resyncs. Also observed Route53 latency for queries hitting eu-west-1 edge endpoints (RTT ~400-800ms). Could be an AZ-specific networking fabric issue.

ops-bot: PagerDuty: page acknowledged by maria. Incident channel created: #inc-3129991234.

maria: immediate mitigation plan: 1) shift traffic weight off eu-west-1 via Route53 weighted records to eu-west-2 (start with 50% shift), 2) drain targets in the affected AZ on the ALB to avoid retry storms, 3) open ticket with AWS (support case created).

dan: I can run weighted shift. Creating change-batch now. Example payload I will apply (tmp):
```
{
  "Comment": "traffic shift for eu-west-1 outage",
  "Changes": [
    {
      "Action": "UPSERT",
      "ResourceRecordSet": {
        "Name": "api.redwood.test.",
        "Type": "A",
        "SetIdentifier": "eu-west-2",
        "Weight": 80,
        "TTL": 60,
        "AliasTarget": { ... }
      }
    },
    {
      "Action": "UPSERT",
      "ResourceRecordSet": {
        "Name": "api.redwood.test.",
        "Type": "A",
        "SetIdentifier": "eu-west-1",
        "Weight": 20,
        "TTL": 60,
        "AliasTarget": { ... }
      }
    }
  ]
}
```

sre-oncall: Approved. Lower TTLs already set for this record, go ahead and shift 50->80% to eu-west-2. Keep change windows small and monitor.

dan: applying Route53 change now via CLI. Command: `aws route53 change-resource-record-sets --hosted-zone-id Z1234 --change-batch file://shift.json`

ops-bot: Change submitted. Change ID: C1234567890. Estimated propagation ~ 30s-2m.

maria: While Dan shifts, Eng-runtime: can you confirm cross-region replicas for the session store are healthy? We want to avoid state loss if we send traffic to eu-west-2. @eng-runtime

eng-runtime: confirmed replicas are healthy for sessions and embeddings (async replica lag < 200ms). We'll stand by to promote if necessary.

support-ops: started drafting status page update. Tentative message: "Partial degradation in eu-west-1 affecting API requests; engineers are shifting traffic and investigating. Some users may see increased latency or transient errors." Need an ETA for a full mitigation to post — can someone provide?

maria: ETA ~30-45m for initial mitigation (weight shift + draining). Full recovery depends on AWS findings. Post the status now as "investigating" and update after traffic shift completes.

neteng: AWS console shows an ongoing "networking fabric" alert in region (support case 987654321) — they report some leaf switches in eu-west-1b are overloaded, affecting route convergence. They are provisioning alternate fabric paths; timeframe currently unknown.

dan: Route53 shift completed. Monitoring DNS query distribution — observed ~70% of queries now go to eu-west-2 at the edge after TTL churn. Backend 5xxs for EU customers dropping from 12% -> 3% in the last 90s.

maria: good improvement. Continuing to drain affected targets in ALB (commands: `aws elbv2 deregister-targets --target-group-arn arn:... --targets Id=...`), and autoscaling healthy AZ instances up in eu-west-1a/c to pick up load.

incident-bot: NOTE: Handoff scheduled in 25 minutes to next oncall: @sre-oncall-next (auto-reminder).

account-manager: looping in a handful of enterprise customers on the weekly SLA bridge — they were experiencing elevated errors. I'll send a concise update once we have AWS confirmation.

maria: request everyone to keep messages concise here. Next steps: keep weighted routing in place until AWS confirms fabric is stable. If AWS indicates >2h for fabric repairs, we'll run a larger traffic migration plan (cutover to eu-west-2 for critical paths).

support-ops: status page updated to "mitigating" with note about Route53 weight shift. RT for update 15m.

neteng: AWS just updated case: performing path remap; expected improvement window 30-60 minutes. They also recommended we avoid re-registering drained targets in affected AZ until cleared.

maria: accepted. We'll keep targets drained and autoscale in healthy AZs. We'll reconvene here on next update or on handoff. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

sre-oncall: closing the immediate page; monitoring channel. If anyone sees a regress ping @sre-oncall.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigation in progress. Severity: SEV-2. Next automated update in 15 minutes."
